**Why the command reveals them:**
By default, `fd` reads and respects `.gitignore`, `.git/info/exclude`, global git ignore rules, and `.fdignore` files to filter out build artifacts, caches, and ignored directories (like `target/` or `node_modules/`). The `-I` (`--no-ignore`) flag disables parsing of these ignore files, instructing `fd` to traverse and return all files regardless of gitignore rules.
